body.purpose: Task editor and ordinary content using SwiftUI .body.

callout.purpose: Supporting labels and chronological activity using SwiftUI .callout.

reviewEvidence.source: Finish reviewer measurements supplied to documenter

limitations: Native appearance and control geometry are authoritative; no browser HTML/CSS replicas are provided.
Appearance pairs are not tonal ramps; no invented ramp is recorded.
No custom motion or web breakpoint tokens exist.
Fixture renders do not verify live SSH, provider login, remote execution, VoiceOver acceptance or active-window focus appearance.
Only the selected provider is persisted in the preview-specific preferences store.

narrative.overview:
This is a narrow extension of the existing macOS product: the approved black cat, system typography, semantic surfaces and native controls supply its identity. The panel stays quiet enough to read a task and its chronological activity without decorative containers.

Its visual hierarchy continually identifies this as a local demonstration. Provider names are labels awaiting remote verification; the interface does not establish live SSH, provider login or remote capability. This document describes only the standalone preview, not a shipped production feature.
keyCharacteristics: Existing black cat and Traditional Chinese interface copy.
Stable environment rail beside a scrollable task workspace.
Native controls and appearance-aware neutral surfaces.
Explicit demonstration, progress, cancellation, failure and result states.

rules.name: The Semantic Surface Rule
rules.body: Preserve AppKit surface roles and the paired appearance overrides; do not freeze a sampled screenshot color into a new palette.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Extend this desktop surface with semantic system text roles; preserve the title's modest hierarchy and readable explanatory copy.

dos: Do reuse the approved cat, native control styling and Traditional Chinese wording.
Do keep demonstration status and provider verification limits visible alongside the task workflow.
Do pair state color with text or a symbol, preserve keyboard commands and allow supporting text to wrap.
Do test both appearances and the minimum desktop width when changing this panel.
donts: Don't present a provider selection, fixture result or completed demonstration as verified remote capability.
Don't replace semantic macOS surfaces with screenshot-derived fixed colors or add a new accent identity.
Don't turn this preview's task layout into a production-wide or mobile design requirement.
